第 1657章 接过使命（第1页）
她是天主之妻，也是她身体内神圣血脉的源头之一。
诺薇达莉在这座黄金墓碑下停下，重重地行了一个礼仪。
不是参加君王的礼仪，而是一个晚辈的礼仪。
当她跪下叩首，将要站起来的那一刻。
圣白色的光在她眼前一字铺开，大地仿佛成为了光铸造的海面，悲壮的墓园化为了神圣的天地，而她身后与身周的一切声音都在远去。
一道挺拔的身影站在她的身前，负手而立，静静地看着眼前的黄金墓碑。
祂没有羽翼，宛若人族，但那淡淡的君王气度，难以忽视。
在诺薇达莉看来，这些都不啊最重要的，最重要的，是她感受到了一种来自于万古的孤寂。
她想起了曾经很多次在游历诸世时，感悟到了道理。
这些是她从无数位君王的身上感受到的。
在她看到眼前之人的时候，她终于明白了，什么是孤寂。
妻子、儿女、部下、后辈、族人，尽皆战死，独留祂还留在世间，为和祂其实并没有多大关系的众生，撑起了净世的天地。
作为圣河天陆的白空天使，她们这一支远离天使文明的主体，已经不知道多少亿年。
她们的称谓自然也从吾主，变为了圣皇陛下。
天使们信仰她们的主宰，但白空天使这一支在分割之后，多数开始坚信自己的力量。
“自从天使文明诸军皆死，整个超脱之上，便没有除了我之外的天使了。”
“她是安温尔的女儿，说起来和你一样，都是出自安温尔这一支。”

这位存在指了指不远处的一座新坟。
“此后，超脱之上，又没有了除我之外的天使存在，直到，你们到来了。”
伟岸存在似乎很欣喜这件事情的发生。
“你们虽然出自于圣河天陆的白空天使一族，很早就和天使主文明断了联系。”
“但在我心里，你们是没有区别的。”
“天使的血脉长河，你们是能融合在一起的。”
“尤其是你，诺薇达莉，你的身体内，流淌着我的血脉。”
“这便是我专门下来见你一面的原因。”
“所以，诺薇达莉，你愿意在这里，接过天使文明一族的使命，点燃灭掉的文明薪火吗？”
这一刻，天使文明的传承与薪火重新燃起！

Chapter 1657 Taking over the mission (page 1)
She is the wife of God and one of the sources of the divine blood in her body.
Novidali stopped under this golden tombstone and performed a solemn ceremony.
It is not the ceremony of a king, but the ceremony of a junior.
When she knelt down and kowtowed, she was about to stand up.
The holy white light spread out in front of her eyes, and the earth seemed to have become a sea made of light, and the tragic cemetery turned into a sacred heaven and earth, while all the sounds behind her and around her faded away.
A tall figure stood in front of her, standing with his hands behind his back, looking quietly at the golden tombstone in front of her.
He has no wings, just like a human being, but his faint kingly demeanor is hard to ignore.
From Novidali's point of view, these are not the most important things. The most important thing is that she feels a kind of loneliness that comes from all eternity.
She recalled the many times when she had realized the truth while traveling through the worlds.
These are what she has experienced from countless kings.
When she saw the person in front of her, she finally understood what loneliness was.
His wife, children, subordinates, descendants, and clansmen all died in the battle, leaving Him alone in the world, supporting a pure world for all living beings who actually had little to do with Him.
As the White Sky Angels of the Holy River Sky Continent, they have been far away from the main body of angelic civilization for who knows how many billions of years.
Naturally, their title changed from my Lord to His Majesty the Holy Emperor.
Angels believe in their master, but after the division of the White Sky Angels, most of them began to believe in their own power.
"Since all the armies of the angelic civilization died, there are no angels except me in the entire transcendence."
"She is Anwen'er's daughter. Like you, she comes from the Anwen'er branch."
The being pointed to a new grave not far away.
"After that, there were no angels except me in the transcendence, until you arrived."
The stalwart being seemed to be very happy about this happening.
"Although you are from the White Sky Angel Clan in the Holy River Sky Continent, you have long lost contact with the Angel Master Civilization."
"But in my heart, there is no difference between you."
"Angels have a long bloodline, you can merge together."
"Especially you, Novidali, my blood is flowing in your body."
"This is why I came here specifically to see you."
"So, Novidali, are you willing to take over the mission of the angel civilization here and ignite the extinguished fire of civilization?"
At this moment, the inheritance and fire of angel civilization were rekindled!
